subjects.name: Dragons, Monsters and Men (Jordan Peterson Daily Wire series)

summary: A watch-through of the first episode of Jordan Peterson's 2022 Daily Wire series, critiquing his advice on what makes a man, his use of dragon and fairy-tale archetypes, and his false claims about agreeableness and epigenetics.

evidence.note: Series name and Daily Wire streaming home introduced; episode one titled What Makes a Man
Peterson's generic self-improvement advice for young men dissected
Segment on his advice to join and not criticise a church, with the Catholic abuse scandal as rebuttal
Archetypes such as the evil uncle compared to screenwriting shortcuts
Peterson's claim to be a biologist challenged
Agreeableness claim checked against a 2022 meta-analysis and found wrong
His masculinity framed as managing and controlling everyone around you
Sleeping Beauty and sword of truth reading critiqued
Dragons guarding virgins rant and its view of what women want
Misuse of epigenetics as unlocking ancestral abilities, corrected

notes: Companion to we-watch-more-of-jordan-peterson-s-new-show (episode two); tagged consistently with it. Benzo detox and Bill C-16 are brief asides, so the covered span stays at 2022. quackery-pseudoscience covers his pseudoscientific biology claims (epigenetics, agreeableness) rather than a fake treatment.
